videos.title: How To Add Claude Skills In 30 Seconds
videos.description:
How to add skills in Claude in about 30 seconds. Claude skills are the easiest upgrade nobody's using.

What are Claude skills? A skill is just a folder with one file inside called SKILL.md. That file teaches Claude how to do one specific job the way you want it done.

How to use Claude skills:
1. Open Settings → Capabilities
2. Turn on code execution (skills won't work without it)
3. Turn on a built-in skill, or upload your own
4. Use Claude like normal. It picks up the skill on its own, no need to call it by name
